name: atomic-explainer
description: An open-source engine for exploring physical objects through a continuous, scroll-driven 3D story.

scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:cli && npm run build:study && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && esbuild src/mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/mcp.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/mcp.js && esbuild src/studio/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/studio.js
scripts.build:eval: vite build --outDir dist-eval && npm run build:cli && node tools/murph-study/build.mjs --packaged dist-eval/murph-study && node --import tsx tools/build-examples.ts dist-eval
